issue: #447 — kani, lean and ledger-replay compiled in one shared target/release on a self-hosted runner and raced on cargo's dep-info files (two jobs red on one run with nothing in the diff)

waived.reason: Workflow-only change [A]: one env line in .github/workflows/proofs.yml (CARGO_TARGET_DIR per job name). There is no Rust hunk to falsify and no pre-existing .rs file to anchor; the measurement is the run itself — run 33729549197 (PR #440) shows the ENOENT under a shared target/release, and the next proofs run on this branch and on every later PR is the falsifier: the same two jobs, separate directories, no dep-info race. Five-whys and the fix are on #447. Second commit: the retry on this very branch (run 33733891100) and #440's (33733445441) failed with the SAME signature in separate per-job target dirs on two runners within two minutes, on the same third-party crate (bashrs). Measured on the host: one shared ~/.cargo registry for 16 runners; the hourly reaper's `find registry/src -mindepth 2 -type d -mtime +30 -exec rm -rf` ran at 09:01:15 and every crate dir now carries a re-extraction mtime from 09:10–09:40 (962 dirs), .crate files re-downloaded in the same hour (394). So the ledger-replay job — the only one here compiling the whole binary from cold — gets a CARGO_HOME private to its runner. Falsifier is again the run itself; the host fix is filed against paiml/infra [A].
